title: Ab Wheel Rollout
summary: A rollout on an ab wheel that makes the abs resist arching, with a big stretch.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for abs (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.6 for obliques (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly obliques total.
Library rating 0.2 for lats: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.2 for lower back: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly lower back total.

setup.text: Kneel holding the wheel under your shoulders.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Roll forward as far as you can without your lower back sagging.
Pull back to the start using your abs.

form_cues.cue: Roll forward as far as you can hold a flat back
Start with short rollouts and lengthen them over time.

mistakes.text: Letting the lower back sag at the far point.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
